name: News
about: Reporting and current affairs from any outlet, Canadian or not. Not comedy about the news.

name: Society & Culture
about: Essays on culture, media, and how society works.

name: Strategy & Leadership
about: Strategy, complexity, management and leadership thinking.

name: Technology
about: Tech industry, products and analysis in general, not specifically AI.

name: AI
about: AI itself: models, labs, research, and commentary on AI as a technology or a force. AI is a tool, not a tactic: if a feed is mainly about getting work done and AI is just how, it belongs in Productivity.

name: Education
about: Teaching, learning science and education policy.

name: Philosophy
about: Philosophical ideas and reflective essays on ethics and meaning, in a scholarly or literary vein.

name: Personal Development
about: Self-improvement and life advice: habits, mindset, relationships, finding meaning in a practical, popular style.

name: Productivity
about: Working methods and tactics: time and task management, focus, habits of effective work, including doing so with AI tools. Productivity is the tactic and AI is the tool, so in a tie between the two, Productivity wins.

name: Note Taking
about: Personal knowledge management: note systems, linking, second brain, Zettelkasten.

name: Creative Writing
about: Fiction, flash fiction and stories, including a writer's own fiction site.

name: Writing Craft
about: How to write: process, editing, publishing, blogging and writing advice.

name: Humor
about: Comedy, satire, parody and mock-documentary, including video series played for laughs.

name: YouTube
about: Only for a video channel that fits no subject folder.
